**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

- **No minimum/volume commitment on Sanofi.** Searches for minimum, purchase, shortfall, take-or-pay, committed budget/FTE returned nothing binding Sanofi to a volume or spend floor.
- **Payments are event- or usage-based only:** upfront (§9.1), milestones payable only on first achievement and aggregate-capped (§9.2), royalties on actual Net Sales (§9.3), and reimbursement of RevMed R&D Costs actually incurred under the approved Research Plan/Budget (§4.5(a)).
- **Research Budget is not a take-or-pay:** it is an estimate under JRDC/JSC governance, with Sanofi holding final decision-making power from CY2021 (§4.2(a)).
- **Supply:** §7.3 only obliges good-faith negotiation of a future Supply Agreement — no requirements or minimum-order term; the sole termination purchase obligation (inventory) falls on RevMed, which favours us.
- **Exit exists:** Sanofi may terminate for convenience in its entirety or country/Product-by-Product (§12.2(a)(i)).
